### Details

This sub-result is attached to [Validator_2_80_1](xref:Validator_2_80_1) and is reported
once per parameter involved in the inconsistency: one for the `read` parameter and one for
the `write` parameter. It identifies the concrete `SNMP/Type` value and the Param ID, so the
offending tag can be located directly.
